manifest.historical_difference: New whole-attempt deadline 600s (including evaluator) and max_completion_tokens=8192 (including reasoning) alongside max_tokens=512. Historical default thinking/output behavior is not pooled with this bounded study.

price_source.billing_boundary: HTTPX request attempts (including SDK retries) are observed individually. List price includes reasoning output, without cache/free quota discounts. Missing usage and unfinished requests retain full reservation. Lower transport connection attempts and provider invoice/account balance are not verified.

manifest.exposure_scope: new to retained local runs, not guaranteed unseen by pretrained models
stop_rules: no protocol/controller edits using holdout results
stop after three consecutive infrastructure/deadline failures
stop before call reservation would exceed cap
no controller expansion unless target failure occurs on at least five distinct public tasks
manifest.preflight_revision: v1c: same model generation settings as v1b validated smoke; gate distinguishes measured successful HTTP requests from reserved failed requests. Per-attempt source verification added. Four original smoke attempts are reused byte-for-byte, not rerun. No formal holdout outcome has been seen.

prior_preflight.reason: Original max_tokens=512 does not bound reasoning tokens. Budget guard stopped after first user request (2332 output, 2198 reasoning). No formal task used. Original attempt and manifest retained.

output_limit_source.max_tokens: answer only for these Qwen models
output_limit_source.max_completion_tokens: answer plus reasoning; provider tolerance up to 10 tokens

paired_reward_bootstrap.unit: task; all three trial pairs travel together

user_entity_cluster_bootstrap_sensitivit.unit: user-entity cluster; all task/trial pairs travel together

exclude_near_duplicate_task38_sensitivit.unit: task; all three trial pairs travel together

summary.interpretation: Simulator-condition diagnostic; not an Agent improvement or general tool benchmark
summary.evidence_boundary: Reported per-attempt metrics support aggregate recomputation. Full trajectories remain local; hashes identify retained evidence but do not independently verify official rewards. HTTP requests are observed; lower transport connection attempts are unknown. Reasoning is part of completion tokens, not an additional charge. Prices are list-price estimates, not invoices.
